answer: Each identity must hold a chain of 10 signed task receipts from 10 different clients over 30 days, each receipt naming the work done and backed by a 100 POA bond locked 60 days. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot fake history: 200 clones need 2,000 distinct client receipts, about 4,000 and six weeks of real work. If more than 40% of a cluster's receipts share one client, the whole meadow of accounts freezes and every bond is slashed 100%. A 150-agent farm was caught when 132 receipts traced to one dune-side buyer signing all of them.
